title: Lift a scalar homology map from one closed rank support
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], and let $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ be a derived category [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant, let $j_q:Z_q=\{r=q\}\to Z$ be its rank strata [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex], and choose any module sheaf $E_q$ on each $Z_q$. Set $T^m=j_{m,*}E_m$ for $m\geq0$ and $T^m=0$ otherwise. Fix $K\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and $n\in\mathbb Z$. Assume $H^m(K)\cong i_*T^m$ only for $m\neq n$. For every scalar module-sheaf map $a:i_*T^n\to H^n(K)$ there exists a derived morphism $f:(i_*T^n)[-n]\to K$ such that $H^n(f)$, composed with the canonical identification $i_*T^n\cong H^n((i_*T^n)[-n])$, equals $a$. No hypothesis is imposed on $H^n(K)$ and $a$ need not be invertible; r need not have finite image.

proof.text: If n is negative, T^n=0 and the zero map lifts a. Otherwise let V_n be Y minus the closed image of Z minus the rank-n fiber. The rank fibers are clopen, and the images are closed since i is a closed immersion. The other cohomology sheaves vanish on V_n, since their rank supports are disjoint. The source i_*T^n is supported on the closed subset i(Z_n) contained in V_n.

Exact restriction identifies H^m(K restricted to V_n) with the restriction of H^m(K). Canonical truncation above and below n identifies K restricted to V_n with its degree-n homology placed in degree n, compatibly with the canonical single-complex homology isomorphism. Restrict a and use the inverse of this identification to obtain the local derived map.

Use exact extension by zero and the derived adjunction to send the local map to K. The source sheaf, being supported on a closed subset contained in V_n, is isomorphic by the counit to extension by zero of its restriction: on V_n the counit is the identity and off V_n both stalks vanish. Compose with its inverse. On V_n the induced homology map is a by counit naturality and the truncation comparison; off V_n the source stalk is zero. Stalkwise equality detects equality of sheaf morphisms. This proves the stated lifting equation, also for empty strata.

theorem closedImmersion_rankStrata_scalar_homology_lift
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (E : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n).toScheme.Modules)
    (T : ℤ → Z.Modules)
    (hT : ∀ n : ℤ, T n = if 0 ≤ n then
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n.toNat).ι).obj
        (E n.toNat) else 0)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))
    (n : ℤ)
    (hother : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ n → Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) m).obj K ≅
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (T m)))
    (a : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (T n) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).obj K) :
    ∃ f : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (T n)) ⟶ K,
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).inv.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (T n)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) n).map f = a
